scope: NPC spawning/death workload and shared path-search budgeting
observations: First activation of each pool slot previously constructed an entire actor inside TrySpawnOne/ActivateSlot: five visual primitives with removed temporary colliders, root/visual/warning objects, components, wedge mesh, arrays and Awake setup.

changes: One prepared enemy per selection update, up to eight inactive actors; immediate mode selection completes remaining preparation during initial spawn grace.
ActivateSlot contains no factory path; normal spawn/death/retry reuse existing objects.
Objective and rescue guidance formatted strings reused until values change.
Lethal damage skips alert visibility ray; stable color property blocks and settled corpse pose writes skipped.
Navigation counts expanded nodes as well as query count: after soft 1200-node frame budget, later searches deferred with caller route preserved. Single full search may exceed budget.
